description: A MandateGuard-style envelope for a single delegated task: the task states its total budget (task_budget_usd in the case context) and the spend categories it covers (approved_categories). Any single action that would push the task's projected total spend over its budget is denied — the envelope is the mandate. Spend in a category the task did not approve needs human approval even when money remains. Within the envelope and an approved category, single actions over $50 still need approval; small in-envelope actions proceed.
fallback_reason: No rule matched (for example, category approval was not stated); the policy denies by default.

rules.reason: This action would push the task's total spend over the budget stated in its envelope (task_budget_usd).
The spend category is not one this task's envelope approves, so a human must approve it.
Single actions over $50 inside the envelope still require human approval.
Approved category, inside the envelope, at or under the $50 single-action threshold.

title: Task spend envelope — one task, one budget, approved categories only
